headline: Tata Power Commissions 300 MW Solar Project in Karnataka
summary: Tata Power has commissioned a 300 MW solar project in Karnataka expected to generate 810 million units of renewable electricity annually and reduce carbon emissions.
why: Tata Power is a major Indian integrated power company expanding its renewable energy portfolio to meet corporate sustainability goals.

impacts.name: Tata Power
impacts.why: Commissioning utility-scale renewable projects expands operational capacity and green revenue streams.
